lines.text: Unlocks: Clear event stage 102810110 · After Final Exams Strategy chat 3. Ein has invited Marciana to join the group.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Attention everyone!

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Our beloved Rei has arranged it so that

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: we'll be doing the practical exam last.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: So no pressure, guys! Hahaha!

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: It wasn't that big a deal,

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: you don't have to blow it out of proportion...

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Isn't this amazing?

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: I can't stop laughing! Haha!

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: I never thought

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: begging and crying would actually work.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Don't call it begging,

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: call it strategy!

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: That might be a bit of a stretch.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: At any rate,

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Rei managed to get us to take the test last,

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: so don't worry so much, and just be careful, you two.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: And if you're seeing this, Tercera,

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: don't forget to come!

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: I still remember

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: how when we were freshmen,

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: we promised to meet up and have cups of parfait together.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Now it's gonna become a reality!
